title: HER前测对CO2还原电极筛选的增量价值
decision_time: Before any CO2 electrolysis, after HER 50 mA cm-2 measurement
primary_outcome: Measured CO Faradaic efficiency at 200 mA cm-2 in percentage points
primary_population: All 441 valid electrode pairs, 230 preparation IDs, 48 nominal element sets
comparison: M0 versus M1 with exactly one additional input: absolute HER full-cell voltage
alternative_budgets: XRF metal fractions + source on unambiguous XRF subset
XRF + 3 XRD summary quantities + 6 mean DFT summaries on exact XRF/source mapped common subset
primary_validation: development 5-fold outer CV grouped by nominal element set, 4-fold nested inner CV of the same grouping
holdout: 10 of 48 nominal element sets chosen using only inputs, 37 electrodes/14 prep IDs; fixed, no reroll. Targets not inspected by model or analyst until one final evaluation after code and comparisons fixed.
training_weights: Each preparation group has equal total weight; row weights normalized to mean 1 within training split
primary_metric: Mean of within-preparation mean absolute errors. Delta = M0 MAE - M1 MAE; positive favors HER.
preprocessing: Numeric median imputation and scaling fit within each training fold. Categorical source/batch uses training-only one-hot with unknown categories ignored. FE predictions clipped to [0,100] for both models; full-cell voltage predictions not clipped.
model_selection: Each model tuned separately within each training fold using identical parameter grids and group-equal MAE; tie uses simpler/first listed setting. RF is primary before results; ridge is robustness, not selected by HER gain.
uncertainty: 10000 paired cluster bootstrap draws of outer-held-out element families, retain all prep groups within each sampled family, compute ratio of summed errors to prep-group counts; percentile 95% intervals conditional on fitted CV predictions.
screening: Candidates are preparation IDs, true and predicted values averaged over electrodes. Top ceil(0.2*N) groups, deterministic ties by prep ID. Recall=intersection/true top-count, enrichment=precision/(true top-count/N); report pooled cross-fit values as descriptive and fold-specific values.
controls: Training-only source mean HER with unseen source global-mean fallback
Training-only batch mean HER with unseen batch source/global fallback
Verified source+batch-number categorical baseline M0B versus M1B; dates not modeled
200 validation-set HER permutations within preparation groups and within batch groups, using correctly trained fold models; permutation is reliance diagnostic, not an exact causal test
Separate H2 FE and CO2 full-cell voltage outputs, with same feature restrictions
Leave-family-out influence and source-specific summaries of primary predictions
quality_sensitivity: Primary retains raw FE; repeat nominal comparison after excluding development rows with CO or H2 outside [0,100], total gas FE >100 or liquid residual <0. Official-clean subset comparison also reported. No normalization of FE to 100.
repeats: Report prep-level SD, within-prep pairwise absolute differences, and top-list bootstrap stability on development data; these do not represent all independent synthesis variability.
five_currents: Secondary CO comparisons at 50/100/150/300 using same split and model settings, only if the second gate supports extension; 200 remains primary.
practical_target: At least 3 percentage points and 10% relative MAE reduction, stable across families and controls. This is an investment threshold, not a requirement to tune until significant.
stop_policy: Stop positive materials-screening route if no stable practically useful selectivity gain, HER adds only batch-equivalent information, or contribution reduces to constant unit correction. Deliver negative/applicability report. May run prespecified sealed evaluation to close the computational question regardless of sign; no new models after unsealing.

unresolved_inputs.XRF: Three relevant electrodes have conflicting replicate-collapsed source mapping; exclude ambiguous XRF from that budget, retain in nominal budget. Reconstructed valid-XRF and official-clean subsets both have 433 rows but are different sets.
unresolved_inputs.batch_dates: 216 electrodes have raw/metadata date mismatch. Only source+batch number is used as batch identity; no chronology claims.
unresolved_inputs.DFT: Summary-file exact XRF/source mapping is an optional published-descriptor budget, not new DFT or proof of identical active phase.
unresolved_inputs.review: 20-record packet and all ambiguities available; automated checks performed. Human review has not occurred and is not represented as complete.

novelty_scope: Original paper including appendices and fixed-version training code plus targeted web searches checked; scaler-transfer HER work and OCx24 exploratory liquid-FE case study are different questions. No exact same validated HER-to-CO task identified in this bounded search; not exhaustive novelty proof.
forbidden_features: Any CO2-stage voltage, FE, partial current, production rate or energy metric
sample/preparation identity as numeric or categorical predictor
scope_limits: Within one public experimental platform; no independent laboratory validation
Predictive information, not causal effect of performing HER or proof of mechanism
No new wet experiments, no GPU purchase, no large new DFT
